MCP: Core Operations and Beneﬁts
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a thin RPC layer over JSON-RPC 2.0 
that standardizes three operations between an agent host and an 
external tool server.
1 initialize
Handshake, version and capability negotiation
2 tools/list
The server advertises typed tool schemas
3 tools/call
The host invokes a tool by name with validated arguments
Everything else - resources, prompts, streaming - is layered on this base.
